analyses.interval: 95% percentile interval of the mean per-task difference in proof rate, resampling modules (2,000 resamples, seed 0)
analyses.perSet: each set's counts and discordant tasks

checks.C13: within a set and task, no goal has two new draws for one occurrence
checks.C14: at least 99% of the searches export through the defined tactic

decisionRule: H64 to H66 are one family, decided by Holm's step-down procedure at family-wise alpha 0.05
developmentChecksBeforeRegistration: scripts/check_faithful_repl.py: 6 cases in a Mathlib REPL with a fixed proposer: the coupled-group search proves a theorem whose two goals share a witness (refine, exact 2, rfl), which the independent-goal search cannot, discarding 2 entangled candidates, and the whole-state search proves it; goals alike up to bound names and up to hypothesis names are merged; a renamed state is dropped; every proof verified from the statement

--develop 3 --budget 16: the three searches with the prover in one fresh set of draws on the first three of search-v0.7's development theorems (outside the corpus; seed 7): all three proved RCLike.conj_mul (at expansion 1) and FirstOrder.Language.Formula.realize_rel₂ (at 4) and not ContMDiffAt.iff_comp_isImmersionAtOfComplement; every search exported through the defined tactic with no failure; no group of several goals arose

measured before registration: the draw throughput of concurrent single completions (840 draws an hour with 8 draws in flight) against sequential completions of one prompt (537 to 634), which kept the concurrent requests; and an export's cost as a run_tac block (about 0.5 s) against the defined tactic (2 to 3 ms)
execution: a unit is one task in one set: the three searches in turn, the order rotating with the task index plus the set, each in a fresh REPL; the sets run in order; a unit that raises is recorded as three error rows and run again, with fresh new draws, on the next resume

hypotheses.H64: over the tasks stated in every set, the coupled-group search proves more tasks than the independent-goal search: per task, the number of sets in which each proves it; one-sided sign test on the tasks where the numbers differ
hypotheses.H65: over the tasks stated in every set, the coupled-group search proves more tasks than the whole-state search: per task, the number of sets in which each proves it; one-sided sign test on the tasks where the numbers differ
hypotheses.H66: over the tasks stated in every set, the independent-goal search proves more tasks than the whole-state search: per task, the number of sets in which each proves it; one-sided sign test on the tasks where the numbers differ

identity: goal_identity.py's export, defined once per task environment as the tactic pg_export_goals (search_faithful.ExportingSession), the run_tac block where the definition fails

measures.cost: expansions, draws (seeded, shared, new) and their tokens, REPL calls and seconds by kind (candidate tactics, exports, harness steps, commands), search seconds
measures.mechanisms: entangled discards (goals), outside-coupled discards and groups of several goals made and used in proofs (groups), faithful duplicate shares and proofs through a goal's later draw (whole)
measures.perTaskCounts: for each task, the number of sets in which a search proves it
measures.proved: tasks with a proof that re-verifies from the statement, per search and set

power: earlier experiments found few discordant tasks between search designs; three sets give each task 0 to 3 proofs per search, and the test counts tasks, not task-sets
proposer: as search-v0.5 to v0.7: BFS-Prover-V2-7B in Q8_0, 16 completions at temperature 1.0, at most 64 tokens, the first goal followed by ':::', duplicates dropped
question: with goal identity taken from Lean's expressions and the prover's draws repeated three times, does a search over metavariable-coupled goal groups prove more than a search over independent goals or over whole states

replicates.0: seeded with search-v0.6's and search-v0.7's recorded draws (7,731 sets), extended with new draws by whichever search needs them first
replicates.sharing: within a set, the draws of a task are shared by its three searches as in search-v0.6 (the n-th expansion of a printed goal gets the n-th set drawn for it)

resultsSeenBeforeRegistration: every earlier experiment, including search-v0.7 in full; keys-v0.1 was running and its results had not been read

searches.goals: search_faithful.and_or_search: single goals merged by faithful goal key, behind a renaming step when hypothesis names differ; entangled candidates discarded
searches.groups: search_faithful.coupled_search: groups of goals coupled by metavariables; a candidate that changes a goal of its own group is kept; a one-goal group merged as in goals, a larger one only if it prints identically
searches.whole: search_faithful.whole_state_search: whole states, dropped when their faithful state key was generated before
